title: Install the package
text: One Composer command in your Laravel app. It adds a service provider and a folder for the site, and nothing else.

title: Pick a template
text: Start from Starter, Blank or one of the landing templates. Every page and section is copied into your app as files.

title: Hand over the words
text: Invite your editors. They change copy and images on the canvas while you keep shipping sections in code.

title: Publish
text: Drafts stay drafts until someone presses Publish. Then the files are written and the change is live, with the diff in your next commit.
